description: This file contains API functions for managing firmware operations such as fetching firmware status, uploading firmware files, activating firmware, and initiating firmware upgrades in a web UI context.

methods.name: getFirmwareStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current firmware status, returning mock data in development mode or real data from API.

methods.name: uploadFirmware
methods.description: Uploads a firmware file to the server, with mock behavior in development mode.

methods.name: activateFirmware
methods.description: Activates a specific firmware bank, with mock behavior in development mode.

methods.name: upgradeFirmware
methods.description: Initiates a firmware upgrade process with specified firmware file and auto-activation option.
